name: Winter’s Bite
body:
Design invocation [cold]; Level 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range 15 ft.
Area cone-shaped burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

A spray of chilling snow and ice sprays from your outstretched hand. Any creature in the area takes 1d4 points of cold damage per caster level (maximum 5d4). A Reflex save halves the damage.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, the range increases by 5 feet, to a maximum of 30 feet. For every two runic charges overloaded, the damage dice increases by one step (from d4 to d6, and from d6 to d8).
